title: Indemnity clause, without doctrine — an exploded assembly: contract and clause plates stack, a promise film registers on its line and the claim plugs into its socket
titleEs: Cláusula de indemnidad — Mecanismo descompuesto en el espacio
description: Exploded view of four components with name tabs: the contract plate ("CT-412 · Supply contract (fictional)"), the clause plate ("Indemnity clause" and its supplied lines), a clear promise film that frames the supplied promise line and carries a rail to a brass socket, and the claim slip with its prong. A tracer follows the supplied traversal order along the supplied relations (plain lines unless a sequence or causal kind is supplied). The layers then assemble: the contract plate slides behind, the clause plate onto it and the film registers exactly over the promise line; the claim slides in and its prong seats in the socket. A scope collar slides over the joint — solid for "Claim covered as per supplied data" (●), dashed for "Scope disputed (as supplied)" (◆). The hold shows the status, the relation legend and "As supplied · no conclusion drawn". No indemnity doctrine.

seed.description: Seed for small deterministic variations (appearance defaults, hand-drawn jitter). Same seed + time + params = same frame.

locale.description: Language of built-in labels (en or es). User-supplied text is never translated.

theme.description: Render treatment. Only tested themes are listed.

palette.description: Colour palette applied to props, actors and accents.

background.description: transparent, paper, white, light-grey, charcoal or a #rrggbb colour.

safeArea.description: Caption-safe margins as fractions of the frame.

reducedMotion.description: Removes decorative motion (overshoot, idle sway, camera drift) while keeping instructional motion.

textVisibility.description: all labels, key labels only, or none (the action must remain readable without labels).

jurisdiction.description: Descriptive jurisdiction tag. "unspecified" means no legal system is asserted.

contentNotice.description: Shows a small "illustrative example" tag inside the safe area.

title.description: Heading of the contract, as supplied (generic, e.g. "Supply contract (fictional)")

clauseTitle.description: Heading of the clause, as supplied (e.g. "Indemnity clause")

clauses.description: Lines of the supplied clause text (generic, fictional placeholders such as "Clause 14.2 (supplied text)"; never real contract text) (array replaces the previous value)

promise.description: The supplied clause line that holds the promise of cover the claim is connected to (1 = first; clamped to the list)

label.description: Label printed on the claim slip (e.g. "Claim 1 (supplied)")

amount.description: Optional amount, drawn only when supplied and always after the words "Hypothetical amount" (e.g. "1,000 units"); empty = no amount

claim.description: The supplied claim (a generic, fictional placeholder)

covered.description: Status "claim covered as per supplied data", as supplied

disputed.description: Status "scope disputed", as supplied (stays an allegation: nothing is decided)

stateLabels.description: Wording of the two supplied statuses (equal weight: ● covered as per supplied data, ◆ scope disputed)

elements.description: Name tabs of the four components; ids are fixed, labels are editable (array replaces the previous value)

kind.description: relation | communication | sequence | causal (causal only when supplied)

relationships.description: Supplied relations between components (plain line for "relation"; an arrow only for a supplied sequence or causal kind) (array replaces the previous value)

relationLabels.description: Legend wording for each relation kind

traversalOrder.description: Order in which the tracer visits the components (array replaces the previous value)

focusElement.description: Component that swells while the tracer is on it

actionProgress.description: How far the assembly is allowed to progress (1 = complete; lower values freeze it part-way)

finalState.description: The supplied status: covered (the scope collar is a solid ring round the joint) or disputed (the scope collar is a dashed ring (same colour and width)). Both have equal weight; nothing is inferred from either

stateLabels.covered: Claim covered as per supplied data
